title: The Foxtool All-in-One: Contact chat button, Custom login, Media optimize images WordPress plugin through 2.5.4 does…
description: The Foxtool All-in-One WordPress plugin up to version 2.5.4 has a vulnerability that allows users with Contributor roles to delete arbitrary image attachments from the media library when the option to delete attached images on post deletion is enabled. This occurs because the plugin does not verify ownership or deletion permissions for a post's featured image before permanently deleting it along with the post.
